scope: A1 amendment reprocess from Object Storage (correction + amendment_law, validated, has-bytes). No Knesset re-fetch.

go_gate.persisted_vs_attempted_explained: persisted == attempted (9975); within-run duplicates 0. Total ops stayed ~flat (10,153 -> 10,125), confirming the prior backfill 'attempted 29k -> 10k' gap was overwhelmingly TRUE DUPLICATES (parser emitting the same op repeatedly), not distinct ops collapsed by the old key. A1's value is correctness (the key can no longer collapse genuinely-distinct ops) and idempotency, not mass recovery.

findings.issue: 150 legacy ops sit on 22 original_enactment + 10 repeal_publication pubs (pilot-derived), outside the reprocess scope (correction/amendment_law). They are valid (fingerprinted, canonical, conf>=0.6) but not re-derived by the current parser.
findings.note: Original enactments and repeals often carry INDIRECT amendments (תיקונים עקיפים) to other laws. The backfill op logic only parsed non-original docs, so indirect amendments across all 420 original enactments were never derived. Completing that is a graph-completeness improvement but needs its own eval (parsing full original-enactment text risks false-positive ops), so it is deliberately NOT folded into A1.
